svg.title: Radiographer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as radiographer, wearing scrubs. Visible work cue: An upright radiograph shows a central spine and three separated pairs of ribs. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face.
